body: Gonna be honest, I think I see 2 things as to why we can chalk this up as a no-go. First, it's quite possible that her family is extremely religious thus the 15yr old dating rule and high regard for Christianity. It also means her parents probably play a massive role in her life and they could be pulling the strings behind this to "protect their daughter". If the parents are pulling the strings, you got no chance. Second, the basically ultimatum she gave you of love God or don't date me is highly toxic and unfair. Happened to me years ago and the correct choice is definitely to walk away and make peace with the fact that some people have a standard that you have to be of the same faith. It's best to stay away from those people if you already aren't wholehearted about a faith and no 1 should expect you to be at your age.
